title: Birds and Bubbling Potion
description: A vibrant surreal scene shows two colorful birds, one green and one yellow, perched on a brown branch. Below them a blue cauldron bubbles with glowing blue liquid and foam while a blonde woman's profile emerges from swirling patterns, surrounded by floating translucent bubbles and glowing colored squares against a dark teal background.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene with a bright green bird and a yellow bird perched together on a curving brown branch. In the lower right a large blue cauldron bubbles over with glowing blue foam and magical liquid. A stylized blonde woman with yellow hair and green eye makeup appears in profile, her form merging with swirling pink and purple face patterns. Translucent bubbles float throughout. Glowing colorful translucent squares in pink, blue and teal drift in the dark teal background with light rays from above.
